description: This Java source file defines the `LookupActivity` class for an Android application that provides a user interface to browse Wiktionary content. The activity handles user search queries, navigation history, background API requests to fetch Wiktionary pages, and UI updates including animations and web content display.

classes.name: LookupActivity
classes.description: Main activity class handling user interaction, content loading, and navigation for a Wiktionary browsing app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads layout, animations, UI components, and handles the incoming intent.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Overrides back key behavior to navigate through history stack or close activity.

methods.name: startNavigating
methods.description: Starts navigation to a specific word, optionally saving current in history, and performs lookup asynchronously.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for search, random word, and about dialog.

methods.name: showAbout
methods.description: Displays an about dialog with credits.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Processes new intents for search queries or internal links to load content.

methods.name: setEntryTitle
methods.description: Updates the activity's title display with the current word.

methods.name: setEntryContent
methods.description: Loads given HTML content into the WebView.

methods.name: onAnimationEnd
methods.description: Callback to make the ProgressBar visible once in-animation ends.
